description: Days 1–7 showed seven ways AI work goes wrong. Look back and they share one move: you judged the work by its own account. Its confident claim, its summary of a tool run, its memory of what's "latest." Part 2 is about…
line: The same agent writes code and tests, so it grades its own work ("Refunds must not exceed the amount paid": it checks each refund, its test passes, and two 6000 refunds on 10000 both go through)
title: Day 8 — Self-Graded Green
